comment: The embedded T3 server: the official T3 Code CLI release archive (Node single executable) of the stable release v0.1.6, cut at the reference pin 2359643cff itself, whose version is CLIENT_VERSION (version-skew.ts). stage-runtime.mjs downloads it, checks it against SHA256SUMS and this hash, and puts it beside this file; the app unpacks it into <T3 home>/runtime/versions/<version> at first launch. T3 Code is MIT (LICENSE-T3).
